playbook.note: No Vietnamese Playbooks translations exist. Keep the loanword 'playbook' (common in Vietnamese incident-response/business content); a literal 'kịch bản' means 'script/scenario' and loses the reusable-workflow sense.

run.note: Noun (a single execution): 'lần chạy'. Verb ('Run playbook'): 'chạy playbook'.

resume a run.note: Restart alias = 'khởi động lại' when explicitly restarting.

checklist.note: Standard Vietnamese term; the loanword 'checklist' is also widely understood but prefer the translation.

task.note: Preferred over 'tác vụ' (which skews technical/system tasks) and 'công việc' (too generic).

status update.note: Aligns with core status = 'trạng thái'. Post update = 'Đăng cập nhật'.

retrospective.note: The published post-run review; 'tổng kết rút kinh nghiệm' is a fuller alternative if space allows.

owner.note: The single person responsible for the run; preferred over literal 'chủ sở hữu' (ownership of property). Run owner = 'người phụ trách lần chạy'.

follower.note: Follow/Unfollow = 'theo dõi'/'bỏ theo dõi', consistent with core.

trigger.note: Noun; follows Microsoft Power Automate Vietnamese convention. Verb 'to trigger' = 'kích hoạt'; core 'trigger word' = 'từ kích hoạt'.

due date.note: 'Ngày đến hạn' is a formal alternative; 'Due' alone = 'Hạn', 'No due date' = 'Không có hạn chót'.

assignee.note: The person a task is assigned to; assign = 'giao'.

invitation.note: Here it means auto-adding members to the run channel; 'Invite participants' = 'Mời người tham gia', consistent with core invite = 'mời'.

run channel.note: Consistent with channel = 'kênh' and run = 'lần chạy'.

broadcast.note: Verb: auto-posting status updates to additional channels; avoid bare 'phát sóng' (TV broadcasting). 'Broadcast update' = 'Phát cập nhật tới kênh khác'.

attribute.note: Consistent with core; here a playbook-defined property field, not a user profile attribute.

section.note: Section name = 'Tên phần'; 'mục' is an alternative but 'phần' better fits a group of tasks.
